title: MEA (Monoethanolamine)
description: High-purity monoethanolamine for gas sweetening and chemical manufacturing.

title: TEA (Triethanolamine)
description: Industrial triethanolamine for metalworking, cement grinding, and cosmetics.

details.longDescription: Triethanolamine (TEA) supplier in Oman - Global Chemicals LLC provides industrial-grade TEA for metalworking fluids, cement grinding aids, and manufacturing in Muscat, Sohar, Duqm, Salalah, Rusayl Industrial Area. Our triethanolamine is a versatile tertiary amine used as an alkalizing agent, emulsifier, and corrosion inhibitor. Essential for formulating metalworking fluids, cement grinding aids, and as a surfactant in industrial cleaners. The viscous liquid neutralizes acids and provides excellent corrosion protection for ferrous metals. Widely used in metalworking industries, cement plants, cosmetic manufacturing, and industrial chemical production across Oman. technicalSpecs: Appearance: Clear, colorless to pale yellow viscous liquid

title: MDEA (Methyldiethanolamine)
description: Premium MDEA for selective H2S removal and gas sweetening.

details.longDescription: Methyldiethanolamine (MDEA) supplier in Oman - Global Chemicals LLC provides high-purity MDEA for selective gas treating and processing in Muscat, Sohar, Duqm, Salalah, Rusayl Industrial Area. Our MDEA offers selective removal of H2S over CO2, making it ideal for applications requiring high H2S removal with partial CO2 slip. Essential for sour gas processing, LNG plants, and gas processing facilities requiring selective treating. The tertiary amine offers low corrosion rates, reduced energy consumption for regeneration, and minimal hydrocarbon co-absorption. Widely used in large-scale gas processing plants, LNG facilities, and refineries across Oman requiring selective gas treatment. The preferred choice for treating gases with high CO2/H2S ratios.
applications: Selective H2S removal from natural gas
Bulk CO2 removal with H2S selectivity
